text: Chronicle strip (your news, default) shows NPC nation foundings but every line is cut off with '...' at 960x540, e.g. 'The nation of Westland was born, with Yvonne J...' - the key info (who/what) is lost; no hover/wrap. Tick ~2900.

After founding Westford, standing at the well the settlement's floating label ('0 here, 1/8 residents') is rendered huge and clipped across the top of the screen, behind the chronicle strip. Tick ~6050.

Built a Farm in my own settlement Westford (K, K -> 'Farm built.', tick 11217) but no chronicle entry was written, while NPC stalls ('A new stall opened in the market of Bluewood') appear in my news. The player's own construction never shows up in 'your news'.

Full chronicle (Y), default 'Your news' view lists 100 of 137 entries at tick ~12000 (73%): other nations' rivalries, alliances and raids (e.g. 'Raiders from Westburg struck Northernland', 'Castleton and Blueton have become rivals') fill it. With ~20 NPC nations founded in day 1, 'neighbours' is almost everyone, so my 16 own entries (yellow, *) are scattered among 84 others. Expected 'Your news' to be noticeably narrower than All nations.

'Only my nation' checkbox narrows to 16 of 137 entries, all mine, all highlighted yellow with * - this is the view that actually makes my news easy to find, but it is off by default and is a separate control from the Your news / All nations switch (two filters stacked; meaning of combo not obvious).

With 'Only my nation' ticked in the full chronicle, the strip (recent view) still shows other nations ('Wendy Davies raised a banner...', 'Smallshire and Castleton are now hostile...') and its header still just says 'your news'. Also my own entry is cut at the verdict: 'Relations between Westford and Littleland are n...' - whether they're now rivals or friends is lost. Tick ~12500.

Building a House made my settlement a Village ('House built. The settlement is now a Village!', tick 13901) - my biggest milestone so far - but no chronicle entry appears; the 'your news' strip at that moment shows only other nations' raids/rivalries/alliances. Expected '* Westford grew into a village' highlighted at the top.

Full chronicle header: '335 entries; the latest 200 are kept.' With 'Only my nation' ticked it now lists 5 entries (was 16 at tick ~12400): 'You raised a banner and named your people Westford', 'You laid the first stones of Westford', Daisy Davies/Smith joining and their stalls are all gone after ~7 game minutes, pushed out by ~40 NPC entries per game minute (mostly other nations' raids/rivalries). The 200 cap is shared by all nations, so my own founding story is lost first. Tick ~21100.
